snippet.title: Super Polished Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2894600?utm_source=trailer1&utm_campaign=youtubedesc

Super Polished is a Top Down cleaning game with procedurally generated levels where you clean up messes, break down larger messes like trash bags or bodies, and deal with mess-causing bugs all while trying to maintain what you've already cleaned and not run out of time.
